name: SimpliFly
category: Program prices, ranges and partial rates
summary: Mesa flight school that gives a budget range and points to an interactive cost calculator.
differentiator: Gives one budget range ($18,000 to $20,000 for private pilot fixed wing) and points to a calculator, so its rates are not readable without running the tool.
pricing: Budget about $18,000 to $20,000 for a fixed-wing private pilot certificate.

estimate.hoursBasis: not stated on the page; the calculator on the page did not show figures without scripts
estimate.note: The page gives a range of $18,000 to $20,000.

feesNamed: Checkride fees about $1,500 for most checkrides, about $2,500 for the CFI initial
bestFor: Students who want a quick budget range and will use the calculator.
skipIf: You want hourly rates on the page.
watchOut: No hourly rates in the page text we read.
The calculator showed placeholder zeros without scripts, so we did not use it.
